limitations: Charts are separate engineering fixtures, not this shadow account's historical returns.
Static market fixtures do not advance through a crash or recovery.
Shadow may update reference and mark-to-market state but cannot execute a trade.
A rejected proposal does not demonstrate a successful paper fill.
Narration VTT is a five-minute presenter draft, not synchronized captions for the short raw video.
Only selected synthetic media is packaged; no browser traces, cookies, environment files, or real datasets are included.
This index does not certify the whole repository/history free of sensitive information.
